normalization: Inputs are explicit 0–100 assessments. Macro: 0/25/50/75/100 for strong negative through strong positive. Network and LP inputs require a documented provider methodology before live use.
missing_policy: Any missing weighted input withholds the score; never reweight missing inputs.
breadth_role: Informational confirmation; not an additional weighted input.
historical_pool_performance_role: Informational prior only; excluded from LP score.
validation: Weights, thresholds and normalization are provisional, not backtested. Scores measure input alignment, not probability, expected yield or a forecast.
